summary: A Sydney CBD cosmetic dentist with four decades of experience appears to lose appointment requests to dead links and a broken form.

findings.problem: Navigation headers labelled Column 1, Column 2 and Column 3 appear to be placeholders linking to #, and Email Us and the footer Request Appointment appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Visitors hit dead ends on the main ways to contact you.
findings.fix: Real labels and working contact links.

findings.problem: The appointment form appears to show hour and minute options as raw text, and a Leave this empty label appears to be visible.
findings.cost: A broken form loses ready patients.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear, and the 199 dollar new patient offer appears to show no terms.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when you are open or what the offer includes.
findings.fix: Visible hours and clear offer terms.

findings.problem: No reviews, ratings or before and after photos appear, and prices appear only as Costs vary.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients compare clinics that show results and prices.
findings.fix: Reviews, a results gallery and starting prices.
